coaching.headline: Boris owned the pits, the duo fed early, and the team won no fight and dealt zero objective damage.

flags.text: Boris went 13/1/5 and took all three Seedlings, two Fangtooths, Mini Prime and the Shaper.
Duo was a damn buffet: Eden and Mourn died seven times before minute ten, the enemy duo once.
Gadget died eight times, four to Howitzer, and trailed Howitzer 8.2k to 12.2k gold.
Enemy scored the last five kills, two on Scarlett, as Howitzer finished the allied mid inner tower.

focus.title: Find Boris before every pit
focus.action: Before each Seedling, Fangtooth or Prime, Mourn wards the pit and Sevarog locates Boris first; Eden, Mourn and Gadget back off whenever Boris is missing from the map.

8.1.call: Lost 1-5 across separate plays as Boris took the first Fangtooth. When Boris is on the pit, the duo stops trading and backs off.

14.6.call: Lost 1-5 after Boris took the second Fangtooth with no ally dead in the prior 60 seconds. Regroup at a tower before the next fight.

17.8.call: Sevarog killed Renna, then Boris killed Mourn, Sevarog and Eden, Howitzer killed Gadget, and the allied mid outer fell. After a pick with Boris unseen, reset.

5c0d6354-1927-4bcb-9eac-96d11cebc36a: Died to Boris outside any detected fight, then Boris took Mini Prime within a minute. One ward all game: if wards are equipped, ward the pit before each Prime.
Seven assists led the allies, plus 45 enemy-jungle minions, yet zero pit takes all game. End invades on a Seedling or Fangtooth when Boris shows elsewhere.
Three of five deaths went to Boris. Duel only after Primeval Roar's barrier explodes, and sidestep Ursine Burst during the hover before the dash.
9b93229a-6973-4b0c-b021-2e3a7fa5f079: Eight deaths, tied for the game high, four to Sparrow; gold trailed Sparrow 7.4k to 12.1k. At low health, leave instead of hiding behind walls: Piercing Shot passes through terrain.
Three deaths before minute ten landed within seconds of a Mourn death. When Mourn falls, walk back to tower; once Heightened Senses is used, hard-engage Sparrow.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: The damn bright spot: 17,523 hero damage, four kills on Grux and the only Boris death of the game. Keep forcing Grux trades whenever Boris shows on another lane.
Three of six deaths went to Boris. Commit only after Detection Protocol is spent, and stand behind Sevarog when Ursine Burst begins the hover.
Took a kill on Howitzer on mid, then died there to Boris inside the same minute. After a kill off the home lane, leave before Boris can answer.
4c311104-fba0-478d-9993-e5143e90d7c4: Kill participation sat at 23%, with three deaths before minute ten. Hold Beguile until Boris or Grux dives Eden, and stay in Beguile range of Eden.
Ten wards and 5,598 healing held up, but the enemy took fifteen river camps to three. Before each Fangtooth, fill Leafsong's three-ward cap around the pit.
4ba3427a-89cd-4c23-9762-c7a5ab200de8: Four of eight deaths went to Howitzer. Step out of Land Mine's blast before detonation, and trade only once Land Mine is used, since Land Mine doubles as Howitzer's escape.
Hero damage ran 653 a minute against an own average of 1182, and two deaths came outside any detected fight. With Boris unseen, play mid from max range.
Answered Sevarog's death with the kill on Sparrow at the duo lane, and took all three allied river camps. Keep rotating to the duo lane whenever the duo fights.

matchup: Boris was the jungle opponent and went 13/1/5, with three of those kills on this jungler.
Into Boris this jungle field wins 48.5% over 100 games.
Tesseract Device heals Boris on hit, and Primeval Roar fears nearby enemies when the barrier explodes.
build: Elafrost sits in the best core, 72.1% over 43 games with Fire Blossom and Inquisition; neither partner was built.
Elafrost empowers the next basic attack after an ability cast, adding area damage and a slow.
Fist Of Razuul stacks while trading and heals for half the empowered hit's bonus damage.
eternal: Krix adds max health that grows per level, plus size.
Nihil is the clear field leader in this jungle cell; Krix, the most played, ranks second.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best and most played Krix pair.
augment: Unholy Pursuit grants two Souls when Phantom Rush hits a hero and resets Phantom Rush when Colossal Blow lands.
Grim Harvest is the clear field pick here; Unholy Pursuit ranks second.
crest: Razorback's Echidna active raises both armors and reflects part of the hero damage taken.
Nyr Warboots is the clear field crest here; Razorback ranks below Saphir's Mantle.
Razorback and Elafrost met the physical armor need against Boris.
improvement: Anti-heal not built: Tainted Guard, bought 49% into Boris against a usual 30%, wins 50% over 990 games.
Tainted Guard cuts the attacker's healing on each basic-attack hit taken, landing on Boris's on-hit Canister healing.
Grim Harvest over Unholy Pursuit is the field-backed swap: Siphon executes low targets, giving up Soul gain on Phantom Rush.

Anti-heal not built: Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic-attack hits against Boris, Renna and Grux.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Mourn Abduct (pull), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Mourn) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush to fly through and fear enemies, Subjugate to chain them in place, Siphon to steal max health, then Colossal Blow to knock them back.
ourKits.winCondition: Farm Souls with ability last hits to reach his tiers, then lock fights with fear and Subjugate while Siphon makes him tankier.
ourKits.passive: Reaper of Souls: ability kills give Souls for bonus health, with tiers adding omnivamp, a magical armor shred aura, stronger Siphon and damage reflect.
ourKits.playWith: A team that turns his fear and Subjugate lockdown into kills.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not walk out of Subjugate while chained, since leaving stuns you; wait it out. Contest his last hits early to slow his Souls, and position so Colossal Blow cannot knock you into his team.

ourKits.combo: poke with Sidewind's Railshot and Tachyon Lance at range, swap with Zero Shift, dash in with Talon Drive and Axiom Strike, then Limit Break once Overheated
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat by damaging heroes and unload Limit Break, flexing between range and melee
ourKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Heat; at max Heat she Overheats and unlocks Limit Break, and Heat decays if she stops hitting heroes
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her keep damaging heroes to build Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: disengage to let her Heat decay before she Overheats; punish melee stance after Talon Drive is spent, and buy anti-heal against her melee stance healing; armor blunts her physical damage

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
ourKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
ourKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
ourKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

ourKits.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
enemyKits.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine to slow and stun, R2000 Missile charged for full damage, then Make It Rain on the held enemies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Lock down space with grenades and mines and rain missiles on enemies stuck in them.
enemyKits.passive: Armed Salvo empowers his next basic with area damage that restores mana, and each ability cast shortens its cooldown.
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokepoints that force enemies into his zones.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Walk around grenades and get out of Land Mine's blast before it goes off. He can blast himself away with Land Mine, so engage after it is used; magical armor helps against his burst.

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

bullets: Chrono Swipe's physical hits applied Tainted Blade's healing cut; ability damage on that Blighted target, like Primeval Roar's blast, made the target take 5% more damage for 3s.
Chrono Swipe's dash set off Wind-Rider's bonus attack speed; damaging low-health heroes fired Weald's true-damage missiles on a per-hero cooldown; Forage added gold and experience per monster kill.
Tainted Blade's 10 ability haste brought Ursine Burst back in about 72.7s instead of 80s at top rank, so more grabs and slams over the game.

Leaving Heightened Senses' stealth set off Wind-Rider's attack speed; damaging low-health heroes fired Weald's true-damage missiles on a per-hero cooldown; Forage added gold and experience per minion kill.
Heightened Senses' attack speed meant more basic attacks, and on-hit attacks fired Scattershot's 2 projectiles toward the closest enemies, limited by a short internal cooldown.
Basic attacks and abilities stacked Relentless on targets up to 8 times; each stack added maximum-health damage to basic attacks and made Piercing Shot deal 8% more.
Area abilities like H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine set off Combustion's splash when off cooldown, and Wraith Leggings added 12% magical damage against heroes below 40% Health.
Aion gave mana regeneration per cast and gold from spell hero damage; Runic Focus scaled magical power with current mana; Bottomless Vial rewarded River Buff kills.
Soulbinder's 20 ability haste brought Make It Rain back in about 87.5s instead of 105s; R2000 Missile hitting heroes from 1450+ range dealt 8% bonus damage.
